integrity: Complete self-contained proof of the claimed first-free-orbit range; finite checker is corroborative and not an infinite certificate. Geometric fixed points are distinguished from orbit quotients. No external certification asserted.
scientific_limitations: Axial order-m rotations on S² and nonempty finite subsets of cardinality <2m only; multiple-free-orbit regime and general group actions not classified. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: A sharp first-orbit homotopy transition in cyclic fixed finite-subset spheres
